searchText: i'm dangerously close to groking delayed validation in ePBS but am still struggling. is it correct that all validators now have more time to validate the block, but the proposer still has the same constraints they have today, because they have to build on a specific state, and publish the resulting hash for the timeliness committee to vote on? The proposer has even less time, but that is not an issue cause it's still several seconds, the proposer was never a problem, attesters are Notice that this is assuming the proposer self builds. If the proposer uses an external builder then it's still beneficial: gets more time on the CL block because the block is forced to arrive earlier
